title: Aromatic Crisp Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A herbal and crisp Catalan dish featuring plum sauce and a mirepoix base, perfect for a post-workout meal. This egg-free friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional Spanish paella.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the plum sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked white rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
